name: Pixel Links
summary: Pixel Links is a calm connect-the-dots puzzle game in a 16-bit pixel art style. The player connects every pair of matching dots on a grid without crossing the lines. Classic is a numbered climb of 4,500 boards that adjusts to how the player is doing, after which earlier boards return turned. Challenge has eight stages that each add a rule, such as a clock, a spinning board or lights out, and a Daily puzzle gives everyone the same board each day. The art was made with AI tools.
